Jack Heart: "For historical scope: dont care about anything other than ltierally this machine and then good practice going forward\nnext review: manabot cutover should be autonomous. we can review the python and CLI APIs"; "go ahead and build"; "can we reduce this machine to only one db also"; "i dont really see how branching dbs really works one you have live state that needs to be generally avaialble across experiments". Current complete design is scratch/exp-12-launcher-migrations.md. Implement it in this checkout and update PR #114. Consolidate actual machine histories and copy-held live work into one operational database shared across experiments and compatible code branches; preserve recovery snapshots and deduplicate inherited facts. Validate snapshots, then autonomously perform real machine and Manabot cutover, including client pin/environment updates and live-work reconciliation, without interrupting remote workers/guardians or starting new paid rentals. Explicit upgrade Python/CLI boundary; ordinary reads never migrate; merged immutable catalog packaged without runtime Git; retain fences, floor, handover and staged compatibility. No automatic operational copies or branch databases. Empty development homes are fixture-only. Next human boundary is Python/CLI API demo, not cutover approval. Auto-merge stays off; no ship/land until review.
